title: Isandro and the Landfall
author: Xanthe Almeida
blurb: Ansel Eriksen, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
